topic: 書包背帶發黑，開學前先看這兩個位置
conflict: 單張近照讓右鞋鞋口被檢查卡遮住，左右鞋與原始狀態難以同時看清。
single_action: 同一隻手只把獨立軌道上的單一卡片向左滑出，兩隻鞋完全不動。
payoff: 鞋口重新完整可見，保留送洗前的原始狀態。
cta: 拍全貌、鞋口與鞋底，LINE 傳來先詢問。
first_frame_direction: 精確 1080x1920 固定直式鏡位；前景是兩隻完整帆布便鞋與獨立淺軌上的單一卡片，卡片遮住右鞋鞋口的視線但不接觸鞋面；中景是一隻成人前臂從左側進入，完整張開的手掌非手指特寫；中後景保留真實洗衣店層次；無文字。
grok_motion_prompt: Create one continuous 6-second 9:16 photorealistic Taiwanese laundry inspection-counter shot. First second already shows exactly two stationary off-white canvas slip-on shoes, one blank matte-grey card held by a separate shallow stainless-steel rail across the line of sight to the right shoe opening, and one broad adult forearm entering from frame-left. One dominant action only: the same relaxed open hand grips only the outer short edge of the single card and slides it laterally left until the right shoe opening is fully visible, then releases and exits frame. Preserve exactly two shoes, one card, one rail and one hand. Keep the full hand silhouette readable without a close-up; five fingers remain anatomically coherent but finger detail is not the focal point. Both shoes and the rail remain fixed, grounded and unchanged. Preserve canvas weave, navy foxing lines, realistic weight, grip, inertia and contact shadows. Fixed restrained camera, motivated mixed fluorescent and storefront light. No cleaning transformation. No extra hands. No duplicate object, card or shoe. No penetration, no floating, no morphing, no readable text, no logo, no watermark, no generated audio. End on the unobstructed shoe opening for one second.
tts_script: 鞋口被遮住，先拍全貌。拍好全貌和細節，LINE 預約台中全區免費收送。

9.5-12.0s：LINE 預約與台中市全區免費收送品牌收尾
category_prompt_directive: 包包類：以提把、包角、拉鍊邊、內袋縫線或輪邊為唯一焦點；只移動一個部位讓細節露出，保留五金、縫線與原有磨耗，不暗示修復完成。
